meta.title: Resale market
meta.description: Permanent Solver licenses listed by other people. Same performance score as the original, and the creator earns a royalty on every resale.
meta.soonDescription: Coming soon: resell the license of a Solver you no longer use. The creator earns a royalty on every resale made on Solvers.

loadFailed.title: Couldn't load the resale market
loadFailed.body: The server didn't respond. Please try again in a moment.

market.title: Resale market
market.lead: Permanent licenses listed by other people. Each one carries the same performance score as the original Solver, and the creator gets a share of every resale.

perks.verified: Verified license. Ownership is checked before every sale.
perks.instant: Instant transfer. You pay and the license is yours right away. The previous owner's memories don't come with it.
perks.sellers: Sellers with a track record. When a seller has a history, we show their badge.

empty.title: No licenses for sale right now
empty.body: When someone lists a license, it will show up here. You can also list yours from your library.

market.count: {n, plural, one {# license for sale} other {# licenses for sale}}

row.samePrice: Same price as a new Solver
row.evalNote: Internal team test (automated checks), not an independent verification.

list.title: List {name}
list.feeUnknownBody: We couldn't look up the fee. Please try again in a moment.
list.cutTooHighTitle: This Solver can't be resold right now
list.cutTooHighBody: The creator's royalty ({royalty}) plus the Solvers fee ({fee}) exceeds the {max} limit on the price. That's why resale is blocked for it.
list.priceLabel: How much do you want to sell it for? (in USDC)
list.errNumber: Use numbers only, for example 25 or 12.50.
list.errDecimals: Use at most {n, plural, one {# decimal place} other {# decimal places}}.
list.note1: You keep using the Solver until someone buys it.
list.note2: Your memories don't go with the license. They stay with you.
list.note3: To change the price later, cancel the listing and list it again.
list.toastText: It now appears in the resale market. You keep using the Solver until someone buys it.
